name: Kyouin no Densa ~Sashidashinin Fumei no Kyoukatsu Tsuuchi~
original_name: 脅淫ノ電鎖 ～差し出し人不明の狂喝通知～
source:
One day, the protagonist receives a message. Which happens to reveal the secrets of 3 girls in his class and with an order to blackmail them too. While thinking that he can freely do anything to them, his desire rises.

"Indecency with teacher", "Shoplifting" and "Bullying". When  their weakness is exposed, they will have no choice but to surrender to him. Following his orders, he will threaten them and violate their body.

[Translated from [url=http://currant.jp/kyouinnodensa/#sto]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
有一天，主角收到一条消息。这恰好揭露了他班上3个女孩的秘密，并接到勒索她们的命令。当他想到自己可以随意对他们做任何事时，他的欲望就上升了。

“猥亵老师”、“入店行窃”和“欺凌”。当他们的弱点暴露出来时，他们别无选择，只能臣服于他。按照他的命令，他会威胁他们，侵犯他们的身体。

[翻译自[url=http://currant.jp/kyouinnodensa/#sto]官方网站[/url]]
